headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 9, 2026**
article:
The Seattle Mariners secured a thrilling 6-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Logan Gilbert leading the pitching effort. The Los Angeles Dodgers dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates 12-3, while the Tampa Bay Rays edged the Boston Red Sox 4-3. The Detroit Tigers routed the Minnesota Twins 10-4, and the Houston Astros acquired 2B Raynel Delgado in a trade with the Tampa Bay Rays.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, with Ronald Acuña Jr. of the Atlanta Braves placed on the 10-day injured list due to a strained left hamstring. Tyler Kinley of the Atlanta Braves has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 8, 2026, with right elbow inflammation. Jameson Taillon of the Chicago Cubs has also been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 8, 2026, with a strained left hamstring.

The Houston Astros have acquired 2B Raynel Delgado from the Tampa Bay Rays in exchange for cash. The Arizona Diamondbacks traded RHP Taylor Rashi to the Minnesota Twins for cash, while the Texas Rangers traded SS Richie Martin Jr. to the Colorado Rockies for cash. The Los Angeles Dodgers traded LHP Antoine Kelly to the Chicago Cubs for cash.

top_news.title: **Mariners Edge Orioles in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a hard-fought win over the Baltimore Orioles, outlasting their opponents by a single run. Logan Gilbert led the Mariners' pitching effort with 6.0 innings pitched, striking out 5 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Rout Pirates 12-3**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates, securing a 9-run victory. Andy Pages led the Dodgers' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Edge Red Sox 4-3 in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 4-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Nick Martinez earning the win. Marcelo Mayer led the Red Sox offense with a double and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Tigers Rout Twins 10-4**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dominated the Minnesota Twins, securing a 10-4 victory. Dillon Dingler led the Tigers' offense with 4 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Acuña Jr. Lands on 10-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Atlanta Braves right fielder Ronald Acuña Jr. has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a strained left hamstring.

top_news.title: **Astros Acquire Delgado in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros have acquired 2B Raynel Delgado from the Tampa Bay Rays in exchange for cash. Delgado joins the Astros' roster following the trade.
